questions.q: Who was the first Indian actor to be honoured with the Padma Bhushan?
questions.explain: Prithviraj Kapoor (1906–1972), patriarch of the Kapoor family and founder of Prithvi Theatres, was among the earliest actors to receive the Padma Bhushan (1969). He is considered the first major superstar of Indian cinema, known for films like Mughal-e-Azam (1960). He also established Prithvi Theatres in Mumbai, which became a major centre for theatre in India.
